assertionEvidence.fact: Each completed case asserts every page has Final standings and identical Final ranking text. Runtime JSON does not retain ranking table bytes; evidence is the frozen source assertion plus that exact passing native case, not an independent recomparison here.
Each accepted UI answer is checked for its own actor and round before uiSolves increments. This summary reads uiSolves, not the absent solves property.

Response diagnostic samples cap at100 per game. status>=400 or duration>1000ms is retained; the slowResponses name does not imply every record is slow. Pending requests are excluded before context shutdown.

409 conflicts are retired before a fresh command; uncertain response/body retries preserve the original payload. An attempt>1 is not by itself an uncertain retry or product failure. Acknowledgement state observations are not HTTP request counts.

qualification: Read-only aggregation of existing actual local normal UI executions at the exact frozen source. No new execution, HV or hosted/physical-device proof. Native nine-case pass plus frozen assertions support eight rounds, per-actor solves and equal rankings; table bytes are not independently retained in runtime JSON. Ordinary safety/presence reads remain enabled; strict push is separate. ERR_ABORTED and response statuses are observations, not established cancellation or latency causes; no old83 count or historic causality is transplanted. Diagnostic sampling and disposal limits remain explicit. Full runtime originals are retained and hash-pinned.
